title: Recognize when catalyst pulsing only changes the clock
statement: If an intact pair has correct hazard k*c(t) and irreversible wrong hazard w*c(t), with k,w>=0 and c(t)>=0, total exposure A=integral c(t)dt gives correct yield k/(k+w)*(1-exp(-(k+w)*A)) when k+w>0, and zero yield when k=w=0. Equal exposure pulses and uninterrupted reaction tie under this model.

requires: Both hazards scale with the same nonnegative catalyst activity and all nonreacted pairs remain in the same state between exposures.
provides: If an intact pair has correct hazard k*c(t) and irreversible wrong hazard w*c(t), with k,w>=0 and c(t)>=0, total exposure A=integral c(t)dt gives correct yield k/(k+w)*(1-exp(-(k+w)*A)) when k+w>0, and zero yield when k=w=0. Equal exposure pulses and uninterrupted reaction tie under this model.
assumptions: No independent aging, clearance, new substrates, changed geometry or selective catalyst response is included. Such changes require a new model rather than this null.
costs: Compare at the same total exposure including pulse/reset work; extra pulses alone supply no modeled correct-yield gain.
contract.units: k*A,w*A are dimensionless hazard integrals; A and k,w use compatible declared exposure units.
contract.obstruction: Identify and acquire a real state-changing recovery operation beyond catalyst rescheduling.

body: Survival is exp(-(k+w)*A). Integrating k*c(t) times that survival over the accumulated exposure yields the formula; splitting A into pulses leaves all absorption probabilities unchanged. This null concerns proportional hazards and unchanged substrate state. Repair can improve matters only by a changed interface such as replenishing damaged handles, removing wrong contacts, changing selectivity or restoring register; the null does not exclude those operations.

evidence.range_scope: Common catalyst-exposure time change and matched uninterrupted comparator.
evidence.status: Exact frozen source bytes; scientific acceptance is scoped to actual version-bound review.

review.scope: Completed source-exposed author reconstruction of the competing-hazard product and uniform bounded-access induction; exposure time-change null; birth-death backward recurrence and first-term clearance bound; negative-binomial frontier renewal and ordered failure/later-success waste sum. Endpoint/order alias, isolated-packet connector law and strict tether/root-survival examples are accepted only at their declared counting/independence scopes. Full scientific notes, response and code were statically read, with no original script, parameter sweep or Monte Carlo executed. Component literature and physical packet/reset/fusion capability are not independently acquired or validated.
